# Floating point and decimal

IEEE-754 binary floats and exact decimal / arbitrary precision. Part of the [data-type comparison](index.md).

Fields prefixed `unverified:` contain at least one claim not confirmed against primary documentation. Equivalent names do not imply identical memory layout or behavior; see [equivalence-is-not-identity.md](equivalence-is-not-identity.md).

## Decimal / arbitrary precision

Exact base-10 fixed-point or arbitrary-precision numbers for money; also big integers.
